devices_rule: anvil substring OR blast_furnace OR smithing_table OR vanilla grindstone; only prefilter, not sole architectural-purpose test
scope_limits: No newly eligible device-signature candidates in this slice, not proof all worlds/buildings lack forges.
Ordinary furnace, cauldron, brewing or generic crafting block does not establish a smithy; no purpose upgraded.
Does not examine roofs/paths/all layers or whole relatedness, and does not count sources/components/hash matches as buildings.
Selected historical index may miss earlier bounded material-only captures; repeats of bounded signatures get no credit.
Metadata size cap and name exclusions omit larger buildings, combination structures and custom mechanisms; no all-local exhaustion claim.
